description: This file defines the class 'EntityExpr' which represents infix (infix) condition expressions used in building database query conditions. The class includes methods for constructing expressions, validation, and generating SQL snippets, indicating it is part of the entity condition handling in the framework.

classes.name: EntityExpr
classes.description: Represents an infix condition expression used in entity query conditions, supporting construction, validation, and string generation for SQL conditions.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for infix comparison expressions, validating parameters and setting lhs, operator, rhs.

methods.name: EntityExpr
methods.description: Constructor for combining two EntityCondition objects with a join operator.

methods.name: getLhs
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the expression.

methods.name: getRhs
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side of the expression.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the operator considers the expression to be empty.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause snippet for the expression based on the model entity and datasource info.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks whether the expression matches a given map of values.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the condition against the model entity.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Freezes the expression into an immutable form.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the condition expression.

methods.name: checkRhsType
methods.description: Validates the type of the right-hand side based on the entity model and delegator.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another EntityExpr.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the expression.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the expression.
